slides.headline: Five people who leave fake 1-stars — and how to tell which one you've got
The competitor.
slides.body: A vague complaint with none of the details only a real customer would know.

slides.headline: The ex-employee.
slides.body: Knows staff names and how things run inside, but describes no visit or purchase.

slides.headline: The wrong business.
slides.body: A real person with a real bad experience — just not with you. Similar name, different part of town.

slides.headline: The extortionist.
slides.body: A wave of 1-stars, then a message offering to make them stop for a fee. Never pay. Screenshot everything.

slides.headline: The pile-on.
slides.body: A news story or viral post sends strangers to your profile who have never been near you.

slides.headline: Each one breaks a different rule.
slides.body: Which one you've got decides how the case is argued. That's the part we handle.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
